submission_review.reason: Independent static review of exact fresh K01/A03 initial request, prepared files, admitted input inventory and source-evidence bindings; the reviewer did not author its science. Seven MIND and eleven Ayele marginal operands/counts agree with the shared evidence. Reported participant SD is allocated into within-sex variance through an explicit total-variance identity, not used directly as residual SD or estimator precision. Bounded-beta/bin-beta ages, conditional lognormal margins, fixed sex quotas, category-mixture BMI, latent sex-specific dependence, target marginal choices and additive meal/multiplicative measurement law are explicitly disclosed unreported assumptions. The Ayele age-bin mean/concentration equations and the sex-mixture moment formulas match the implementation; no scientific parameter was fitted or sampled during review. The source descriptor correctly names Accu-Chek; target CareSens-model uncertainty does not establish assay equivalence. The declared 1e-12 CDF clipping and preceding-representable bin endpoint convention are numerical approximations, not clinical eligibility filters. Generation contains bounded sex-category and one-or-three reading loops, with no optimizer, host I/O, seed search, whole-cohort redraw, sample-moment rescaling, row deletion or clinical-value repair. Exact three contexts, canonical five-column mmol/L schema, source age supports and target age>=40 are retained. Mandatory external whole-frame guards remain responsible for rejecting nonfinite/invalid outputs; no runtime success is claimed. The six composite-diabetes ORs and ten abstract records remain contextual. No submitted generator was imported/run and no actual target record, target effect or other generated outcome was consulted. Approval covers implementation/provenance/semantic consistency, not strict source replay, transport or target validity.

k01_declaration_review.reason: Independent review of this actual K01/A03 descriptive declaration and full model-spec binding. Exact submission/declaration hashes, current declared engine hashes, shared evidence bytes, model specification, context assumption lists and all eighteen fixed source diagnostics were verified. Means and participant SDs, ddof1, equal-row whole-frame denominators, source count ratios, half-open completed-year age diagnostic bins and literal BMI normal interval with its preserved gap remain prospective labelled approximations; source weights and exact SD conventions remain unknown. The author supplies explicit sex, within-bin, dependence and measurement/transport assumptions and no descriptive proxies. Whole-frame context guard and verified semantic-v1 must precede any descriptive arithmetic; strict replay remains unavailable. This approval permits only the previously fixed source comparison procedure, not additional trials, target feedback, exact source replication or scientific validity claims.
